recommendations.detail: Structured data gives LLMs machine-readable context about your content (product details, pricing, reviews). Without it, LLMs must infer meaning from unstructured text.

Parity 0% — CSR contains 220 more words than SSR (220 vs 0). That delta is JS-injected content invisible to LLM crawlers (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity all fetch the raw HTML).

Examples of content only visible after JS executes:

  • "What does your offer actually mean?"

recommendations.title: Complete Open Graph tags
recommendations.detail: OG tags provide AI systems with canonical title, description, and image. Missing tags mean LLMs must guess what to show users.

recommendations.title: Add canonical URL

recommendations.title: Create /llms.txt
recommendations.detail: The llms.txt convention (like robots.txt for AI) provides a structured summary of your site for LLM crawlers. See llmstxt.org for the spec.

recommendations.title: Serve markdown via Accept header
recommendations.detail: Some AI crawlers request text/markdown. Serving a markdown version improves content extraction quality. Cloudflare and some CDNs can automate this.

csr: What does your offer actually mean?

onlyInCSR: No data stored. All calculations run locally.
What does your offer actually mean?
See what your salary really gets you after taxes, rent, and cost of living. Compare two offers side by side.
Your base offer before taxes — what's in the offer letter.
Where you'll be living and working.
No signup. No data stored. 2025 tax brackets, rent as of Nov 2025.

Take-home payuses 2025 federal tax brackets (single filer), the $15,750 standard deduction, 2025 FICA rates (6.2% Social Security up to $176,100, 1.45% Medicare uncapped), and each state's 2025 income tax brackets, standard deduction, and exemptions as published by its revenue department. Local income taxes are included for NYC, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Baltimore, Detroit, Grand Rapids, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Columbus, Indianapolis, Louisville, Lexington, Kansas City, St. Louis, Birmingham, Wil
Rent uses median 1-bedroom rents as of November 2025 (Zumper National Rent Report, November 2025, and Apartment List metro-level data, 2025).

Essentials (food, utilities, transit, phone, personal care, healthcare premiums) uses a $1,200/month national baseline scaled by city cost-of-living index. Sources: MIT Living Wage Calculator and BEA Regional Price Parities.
These are estimates for educational purposes. Your actual take-home and expenses will vary based on benefits, deductions, lifestyle, and personal choices.
